title: Not Tim's trackers
description: A resource pack that changes the stick texture, when renamed, to be a icon to help tracking when video editing.
body:
The goal of this resource pack is to create an easy tracking system for content creators.
to get the tracking icon rename a stick via an anvil to "**NTs tracker**"
**IF YOU DO NOT MATCH THE CASE IT WILL NOT WORK!!!**
Then, place the stick in a item frame and TADA, you've got trackers!
